brief.intent: An energetic design field for developers and art directors: strong type contrast, asymmetric imagery, tactile counterpoint, deliberate nonzero tension, and readable controls before spectacle.
brief.title: Make the rules. Then bend them.
brief.body: Pull a value. Watch the whole composition answer. Keep the reasoning with the result. Compare a retained direction, inspect its constraints, and replay the choices that made it.

provenance.readout: quantized last-position logits restricted to declared answer slots; no generated tokens

selection.caveat: Option logits are used only to select a viable alternative. No confidence, validity or aesthetic score is exposed.

validation.scope: Exact field finalist typography/image/action fixture only; layout and source loading verified. Whole gallery, native, physical devices, accessibility, material appearance and motion choreography require separate evidence.

lookahead.scope: Witnesses cover declared direct successors under retained parent assignments. No recursive DAG optimum, summed cross-stage objective, renderer or preference verification. Unknown branches are not proven impossible.

scope: Source-bound typography tables are measured. Coupled full compositions and material/motion appearance remain unrendered until finalist verification. Preference pressures are dimensionless authored tradeoffs, not physical forces or beauty.
